task: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First of all, take the TextWorld limited edition keycard from the desk. And then, take a trip north. That done, unlock the TextWorld limited edition gateway with the TextWorld limited edition keycard. And then, open the TextWorld limited edition gateway in the cellar. And then, venture north. And then, make an attempt to move west. Then, travel south. Then, try to travel west. Okay, and then, venture north. Then, pick up the passkey from the bureau within the study. After that, go to the west. Then, unlock the hatch within the cookhouse. Once you have unlocked the hatch, ensure that the hatch is open. After that, try to go west. That done, make an effort to travel south. With that accomplished, pick-up the fly larva from the floor of the studio. Got that? Good!
